en.description:
50 quick games made for Apple Watch. Raise your wrist, play a round, and get back to your day.

Every game is built for the small screen. Turn the Digital Crown to steer, tap to jump, hold to charge, swipe to slide. Rounds last from a few seconds to a few minutes, and each game gets harder the longer you last.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• 50 games in one app, from arcade to puzzle
• The Digital Crown works as a real game controller
• Haptics and sound for every catch, hit and crash
• Your best score saved for every game
• Pause any time

GAME HIGHLIGHTS
• Crown Bricks: break bricks across 100 levels with a paddle you steer by the Crown
• Lane Racer: weave through traffic, with bonus meters for near misses
• Paper Glider: tap to lift your glider through narrowing gates, with a new sky every 10
• Busy Street: hop the raccoon across roads and rivers; long runs unlock new heroes
• 2048: swipe to merge tiles, reach 2048, then keep going
• Memory Match: find every pair before the 3-minute clock runs out

And 44 more arcade, reflex and puzzle games to discover.

ON YOUR IPHONE
Browse every game, watch an animated preview of each one, and read how it plays before you start it on your wrist.

Pick a game and beat your best.
en.releaseNotes:
- 29 new games to play, for 50 games in all
- Tap Instructions on the Pause screen to see how any game plays
en.subtitle: Offline Arcade for Watch
